about: compiler/native: Stop 1 lowering from checked compiler/ir into nativeobj/EIR v1. Each row breaks one soundness, ABI, or refusal contract and is killed by compiler/native's laws and archive verification test.

mutants.name: native-map-type-accepted
mutants.rule: Unsupported Go/Ergo types outside Stop 1 (such as maps) fail closed with nativeobj.Refused.

mutants.name: native-unit-call-gets-dst
mutants.rule: Calls to unit (0-result) functions emit zero destination slots so nativeobj.Check and ABIInternal match the callee signature.

mutants.name: native-unit-call-as-value
mutants.rule: Using a unit function in a value expression is refused with nativeobj.Refused instead of failing later as Malformed.

mutants.name: native-range-continue-skips-step
mutants.from:
emit(st, nativeobj.Jump{To: end}, at)
			emit(st, nativeobj.Label{Id: body}, at)
			pushLoop(st, step, end)
mutants.to:
emit(st, nativeobj.Jump{To: end}, at)
			emit(st, nativeobj.Label{Id: body}, at)
			pushLoop(st, top, end)
mutants.rule: A continue inside a range loop jumps to the increment step before rechecking the loop bound.

mutants.name: native-init-not-refused
mutants.rule: Package init functions are refused explicitly instead of failing nativeobj.Check as Malformed.

mutants.name: native-unknown-call-accepted
mutants.from:
case option.None:
		return refuse(*st, "call of \(name), no function of this package")
mutants.to:
case option.None:
		return nativeobj.Malformed{Why: "call of \(name), no function of this package"}
mutants.rule: Calls to unknown functions not in the package or its declared imports fail closed with nativeobj.Refused.

mutants.name: native-stop1-multi-file-collapsed
mutants.from: let files = if u.IR.Files.Len() > 0 { u.IR.Files } else { []string{u.File} }
mutants.rule: FromIR preserves all source filenames from u.IR.Files for multi-file packages.

mutants.name: native-stop1-foreign-calls-dropped
mutants.rule: Foreign calls invoked by local functions must be exported in the foreign call list encoded into EIR v1.

mutants.name: native-stop1-field-lit-swaps-order
mutants.rule: Record literals assign each named field expression by resolved schema field index rather than literal element order.

mutants.name: nativeobj-exec-imports-unsorted
mutants.rule: fromIRWithForeign must sort used imports by path to match EIR v1 canonical HImports table order and Verifier expectations.

mutants.name: nativeobj-exec-toiface-dropped
mutants.rule: toiface expressions must emit MakeIface into an interface-typed slot rather than returning the unboxed concrete slot.

mutants.name: nativeobj-exec-fail-single-result
mutants.rule: fail inside a (T, error) function returns a zeroed T slot paired with the boxed error slot.
